items.title: AbbVie (ABBV) Reports Positive Phase 3 QULIPTA Migraine Trial Results
items.summary: AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) reported positive Phase 3 TEMPLE trial results for QULIPTA in migraine prevention against topiramate. The TEMPLE study found QULIPTA achieved superior tolerability compared with topiramate in adults with migraine. QULIPTA also showed better efficacy than topiramate on key migraine prevention endpoints in the Phase 3 TEMPLE trial.
